comparison.objective: Push a shower-valve cartridge fully home against O-ring resistance and install its U-shaped retaining clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain axial force and angular alignment with one hand while inserting a close-clearance clip with the other.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires the cartridge flush and square, clip fully seated, retention under a 20 N pull, hands clear, and a one-second hold; a dropped clip fails.
comparison.reason: It shares genuine bimanual stabilization, but tests simultaneous press-and-clip insertion against spring-back, not two-tool screw/nut countertorque, target-angle preservation, and repeated cycling.
